confirmed_defects.title: Regenerate restarted after weather cancellation or a newer user action
confirmed_defects.reproduction: Actual Regenerate onclick, actual automatic-weather coordinator and actual method/context/Cancel functions with a deferred weather transport. All three cancellation routes still invoked generate once after the coordinator returned cancelled. Manual cancelled rendering still navigated to Outfits.
confirmed_defects.repair: Own a generation token, recheck after weather, stop on cancelled weather, pass ownership through manual apply, suppress stale navigation/error publication.

confirmed_defects.title: Curated and Visual candidates consumed capacity before explicit rejection filtering
confirmed_defects.reproduction: Curated Work had 15 rows. Rejecting S10/DS022/T022 clothing yielded 14 although 5 permitted rows fit the remaining capacity. Visual candidates also reached render/evaluation before the outer final veto.
confirmed_defects.repair: Retain authoritative feedback dependency. Filter static owner constraints and saved rejections before Curated shortlist, history priority and capacity. Filter proposed Visual outfits before rendering/evaluation. Validate captured feedback through durable assertCurrentAsync after every async Visual boundary and before issuing options. Keep final outer veto.
confirmed_defects.observed_recovery: 15 Curated choices retained with permitted S11/DS022/T022 replacement; no unintended global T022 exclusion.

confirmed_defects.title: Cached feedback checks missed an already committed peer rejection before visual image assessment
confirmed_defects.reproduction: Actual IndexedDB facades share one database but have BroadcastChannel disabled. A peer commits a clothing rejection during propose. Synchronous refresh/assertCurrent still used the old generating-facade cache, allowing 20 private renders and 20 fixture evaluation images including the rejected outfit. The final durable publication guard rejected the result; this was not a final-display bypass.
confirmed_defects.repair: Use the dependency atomic assertCurrentAsync where available, before propose and after each awaited stage; recheck cancellation and dependency identity. Retain synchronous pool/capacity filtering and final publication veto.
confirmed_defects.observed: No BroadcastChannel: commit during propose produces 0 renders/0 evaluations; commit during first render produces 1 render/0 evaluations; commit during evaluate prevents result publication. Healthy real-database continuation succeeds.
confirmed_defects.counted_with: The same 23-check hybrid suite; not an additional 23 tests.

harness_findings.finding: Common tied Work/dress-trouser fixture violates B01 and B11 owner rules. It must not be used to certify supported rendering.
harness_findings.repair: Retain explicit blocked tests. B11 uses No Tie. B01 uses actual reviewed exploration with B01/PT006/DS026/NO_TIE/shoe-8, dinner, explicit summer_weekend_dinner. Exact discovery considered 1 clothing state and 1 shoe; native selection/owner policy validated locally. Browser route requires all 15 blazer IDs, identical baseline pixels, no approval or Home substitution claim.

harness_findings.finding: Missing DejaVu font caused atlas finally to fail before saving RESULT.
harness_findings.repair: Use Pillow default font fallback; preserve primary failure and save RESULT in inner finally even if atlas fails.

harness_findings.finding: Favorites storage listener may replace the queued modal before rejection; the obsolete error must then be suppressed.
harness_findings.repair: Require either a fresh refusal or exact cross-tab-refresh notice plus a recorded new non-null storage event. Durable preservation and explicit retry remain mandatory. Later WebKit transport-cache harness refinement is UI-owner work.

limitations: No local browser was launched; real Chromium/WebKit evidence is produced in root-coordinated CI.
The Regenerate test executes actual orchestration with deferred endpoint spies; it is not a pixel test.
The Visual tests use an in-process service fixture. They prove local eligibility and lifecycle boundaries, not remote model quality.
A remote proposal may itself name a banned outfit; local filtering now excludes that proposal before rendering, provider evaluation, rotation and capacity.
Curated and Visual remain finite/shortlist-based modes. The fix does not promise 20 choices or implement automatic refill for them.
This report is the fourth coordinated round contribution, not five independent whole-app passes.
